teacher_info.introduction: ABOUT ME -Hi everyone! I’m Yuwanes. I have a Degree in TESL. I have been teaching English and Malay to students and adults from beginners to advance level from around the globe. -I am a multi-lingual speaker of English, Tamil and Malay, and now learning Mandarin, Korean and Japanese as I find learning new languages fascinating. -Being raised in a multi-cultural society allows me to understand the cultural differences and learner’s needs for learning a new language. TEACHING STYLE -I focus on conversations as I believe that conversing is the most efficient way to learn a new language. -We can discuss any topic you like. Through this, I hope to expand your vocabulary, idioms, phrasal verbs and more. If there are any mistakes made such as pronunciation, grammar, word usage, etc, I will help to correct your mistakes. -Depending on your level and interest, I use various teaching resources such as videos and article to aid better listening and speaking. -For advanced speakers, I like to discuss topics that challenge learners. -You can have writing homework so we could discuss & analyze them -I am friendly, patient, and easy going who can talk about anything and quite versatile towards your learning needs and style. ENGLISH -I can help with both British English and American English from beginner to advanced learners from ages 8 and above. *If you are interested, I can also teach you English creole-based language, MANGLISH, and SINGLISH which is widely spoken in Malaysia and Singapore respectively. MALAY - Formal Malay is very different than informal Malay that native speakers use. -I teach both formal and colloquial Malay, including Malay for travelling from beginner to advanced learners. -For beginners, you will learn to read Malay in just one lesson. We will then continue with the basics of the language, where I will explain the usage and grammar. -For intermediate & advanced learners, let’s have conversations just like the native speakers! -I hope to see you soon!
